description: Fillet fish and trim meat with two FR3 arms and a real flexible fillet knife held in authored knife-handle inserts: take the knife, head a gutted trout, fillet one side or the whole fish and lay the fillets skin-down, remove belly bones; trim, excise and portion a salmon half side; remove the chain, denude and slice medallions from a pork tenderloin. Cuts, tears and separations come only from the knife-edge law, cohesive interfaces and bone mechanics.
count_scope: twelve named tasks (trout: take-knife, put-away-knife, head-off, fillet-one-side, fillet-whole-fish, remove-belly-bones; salmon-side: trim-belly, excise-defect, portion; pork-tenderloin: remove-chain, denude, medallions); seeds vary the workpiece (length +-5 % with mass ~ L^3, rib and pin-bone counts) and its pose. Two designed tasks are not supported by this build and are rejected by the resolver with the reason: pin-bone (the tweezers are not a physical tool yet) and skin (skin cannot separate with under 10 % flesh on a 3.5 mm mesh). put-away-knife is offered on dual-fr3 only.

evaluator.scope: Physical state only: tissue fragment connectivity and each tet's rest reference label (where every gram came from), thin-bone pieces and what they are bonded to, rigid-bone joints, knife grasp, placement against tray and bowl footprints, per-tick blade-hand contact and compression histories. Evaluators are implemented task by task; a task without one reports so in its evaluation note. No autonomous-solution claim. Bare existing selections keep filleting/task.py; the filleting-tasks-v1 contract uses filleting/task_set_evaluator.py. The whole-fish task keeps its own evaluator.

qualification: See filleting/REPORT.pdf for what is qualified by which probe or assisted demonstration, runtime and limitations.
contract_selection: Existing tasks default to legacy. Select filleting-tasks-v1 for take-knife, head-off, portion, medallions, excise-defect and remove-chain. put-away-knife defaults to the new contract; fillet-whole-fish keeps its own evaluator.

task_set.score_rule: 1 on success, else 0.95 x continuous physical-state progress; untouched start 0.
task_set.limitations: Failed assisted demonstrations do not show that these tasks are impossible; they are open risks. trim-belly has no recorded successful separation either. pin-bone (B1) and skin (B4) stay refused.
task_set.qualification: Tested with constructed states and stubs only; the filleting-tasks-v1 evaluator has not yet been run with the simulator.
